verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) directly support this workflow: PIRs integrate with the incident lifecycle and Slack data, and the Scribe Agent can join incident calls to transcribe and build chronological narratives, with AI-generated PIRs now GA and startable from the incident detail page or Slack — covering drafting-from-timeline and some review flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of postmortem templates, a formal review/approval step before publication, and evidence of publishing PIRs to a wider audience/stakeholder page.
